topics: Basic Structure of computers :– Functional units - Basic operational concepts
CISC vs RISC architectures:- RISC Introduction - Assembly Language, Assembler directives, Assembling.
Programming concepts - Program flow, Branching, Conditional statements, Loops, Arrays, Function calls
Machine language - Instructions, addressing modes, Stored program concept.
Single-Cycle Processor - Single Cycle Datapath, Single Cycle Control
Pipelined Processor - Pipelined Data Path, Pipelined Control
Caches - basic concepts, Cache mapping, Cache replacement, Multiple-Level Caches
Embedded I/O Systems - Embedded I/O, General Purpose I/O, Serial I/O, Other Peripherals.

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 2 marks (8x2 =16 marks)

partB.description: 2 questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered. Each question can have a maximum of 2 subdivisions. Each question carries 6 marks.  (4x6 = 24 marks)

courseOutcomes.description: Identify the basic structure and functional units of a digital computer and the features of RISC architecture.
Experiment with the single cycle processor, pipelining, and the associated problems.
Utilize the memory organization in modern computer systems.
Experiment with the I/O organization of a digital computer.
